content.hebrew: קהל: מִ֭י כַּיו֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ הַֽמַּגְבִּיהִ֥י לָשָֽׁבֶת׃ הַמַּשְׁפִּילִ֥י לִרְא֑וֹת בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ: (תהלים קיג:ה-ו)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Mi kadonai elohenu hammaḡbihi lashavet: hammashpili lir’ot bash’shamayim uva’arets:
content.english: Cong. Who is like Adonai our God, who makes His seat high up, yet lowers Himself to look upon heaven and earth? (Ps. 113:5–6)

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   אֲשֶׁר מִיַּד פַּרְעֹה שִׁלְּחָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai asher miyyad Par‘o shilleḥanu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who sent us forth out of Pharaoh’s hand?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי  הַמּוֹלִיכֵֽנוּ בַמִּדְבָּר, וּבֶעָנָן הִנְחָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai hammolikhenu vammidbar, uve‘anan hinḥanu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who led us in the wilderness, and guided us with the cloud?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי  רָם וְנִשָּׂא, דֶּֽרֶךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּים לֹא נָחָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai ram venissa, derekh Pelishtim lo naḥanu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, lofty and high, who did not direct us along the way of the Philistines?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי  נְכוֹחָה יִשְּׁרָֽנוּ לְהַחֲיוֹת רוּחֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai nekhoḥa yish’sheranu lehaḥayot ruḥenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who had us walk straight, to keep our spirit alive?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   חֲמֻשִׁים מִנּוֹף הֶעֱלָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai ḥamushim minnof he‘elanu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who brought us armed out of Nof?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   חִזֵּק לֵב צָר לְרָדְפֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai ḥizzek lev tsar lerodfenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who strengthened the enemy’s heart, to chase us?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   אָמַר "הִתְיַצְּבוּ!", וְלֹא הֶאֱבִיד נִצְחֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai amar “hityats’tsevu!” Velo he’evid nits’ḥenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who said: “Stand your ground!”, and did not let our continuity perish.

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   בָּקַע יָם וְהֶעֱבִירָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai baḳa‘ yam vehe‘eviranu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who split the Sea, and passed us through it?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   שָׂם מַאֲפֵל בֵּינֵֽינוּ וּבֵין צָרֵֽינוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai sam ma’afel benenu uven tsarenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who placed darkness between us and our enemies?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   הִשְׁקִיף, וַיָּֽהָם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה אֹיְבֵֽינוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai hishkif, vayyahom et maḥanē oyevenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who looked down, and confounded our enemies’ camp?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   נִעֲרָם בַּיָּם, וְרָאוּ עֵינֵֽינוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai ni‘aram bayyam, vera’u ‘enenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who tossed them around in the Sea, which our eyes saw?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   הִמְתִּיק בְּעֵץ מַר מֵימֵֽינוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai himtiḳ be‘ets mar memenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who sweetened our waters with bitter wood?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   אִם נַאֲזִין לְמִצְוֹתָיו, יְהִי רֹפְאֵנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai im na’azin lemitsvotav, yehi rof’enu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who will be our healer if we listen to His commandments?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   דַּלְתֵי שָׁמַֽיִם פָּתַח בַּעֲדֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai daltē shamayim pataḥ ba‘adenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who opened the gates of heaven on our behalf?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   הִמְטִיר מָן מַאֲכָֽלֵנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai himtir man ma’akhalenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who rained down manna as our food?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   לְהָכִין לֶֽחֶם מִשְׁנֶה בַּשִּׁשִּׁי צִוָּֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai lehakhin leḥem mishnē bash’shish’shi tsivvanu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who commanded us to prepare a double portion of bread on Friday?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   בִּגְלַל שַׁבָּת הֵכִין צָרְכֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai biḡlal shabbat hekhin tsorkhenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who prepared our needs on account of the Sabbath?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   שְׂלָו הֶאֱכִילָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai selav he’ekhilanu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who fed us quail?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   בָּקַע צוּר, וּמַֽיִם הִשְׁקָֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai baḳa‘ tsur umayim hishḳanu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who split a rock, and gave us water?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   צִוָּה לִמְחוֹת זֵֽכֶר עֲמָלֵק שֹׂטְנֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai tsivva limḥot zekher ‘amaleḳ sotenenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who commanded to blot out the name of Amalek, our adversary?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   אָמַר לְהִלָּחֵם בּוֹ רֹאשׁ נְבִיאֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai amar lehillaḥem bo rosh nevi’enu
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who said [to] the head of our prophets to fight against [Amalek]?
content.comments: The head of our prophets. Moses.

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   גָּזַר לְהִלָּחֵם בּוֹ עַד בֹּא מְשִׁיחֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai gazar lehillaḥem bo ‘ad bo meshiḥenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who decreed to fight against [Amalek] until the coming of our Messiah?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   שָׂם כָּל־יָקָר נִכְחֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai sam kol yaḳar nikh’ḥenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who placed all glory in front of us?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   אִשֵּׁר אָרְחֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai ish’sher orḥenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who made our path firm?

content.hebrew: מִי כַּיוי   יֶאֱסֹף נִדָּחֵֽינוּ.
content.transliteration: Mi kadonai ye’esof niddaḥenu.
content.english: Who is like Adonai, who will gather in our scattered people?

content.hebrew: קהל: מִי כַּיוי   יִקְרָא דְרוֹר, פְּקַח־קֹחֵֽנוּ.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Mi kadonai yiḳra deror, peḳaḥ ḳoḥenu.
content.english: Cong. Who is like Adonai, who will proclaim liberty, to release us [from exile]?

content.hebrew: חזן: כִּ֥י מִי־אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יו֑י וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ: (שמואל ב כב:לב)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ki mi el mibbal‘adē Adonai umi tsur mibbal‘adē elohenu:
content.english: Cantor. For who is God besides Adonai, and who is a rock besides our God? (2 Sam. 22:32)

content.hebrew: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭ל֖וֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יו֑י וּמִי־צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ: (תהלים יח:לב)
content.transliteration: Ki mi Elo’ah mibbal‘adē Adonai umi tsur zulati elohenu:
content.english: For who is God besides Adonai, and who is a rock other than our God? (Ps. 18:32)

content.hebrew: אֵֽין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיו֖י כִּי־אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּֽאלֹהֵֽינוּ: (שמואל א ב:ב)
content.transliteration: En ḳadosh kadonai ki en biltekha ve’en tsur kelohenu:
content.english: There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none besides You; and there is no rock like our God. (1 Sam. 2:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (תהלים כב:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’atta ḳadosh yoshev tehillot Yisra’el:
content.english: Congregation: And You are Holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
